# Bruxelles programme samples

Small public programme excerpts captured on 7 November 2026 for offline regression tests. HTML excerpts retain the site's selectors and dates; the Ciné Boutique JSON contains only the film and session fields used by the scraper. No login, payment, customer or booking-page token data is included.

- Aventure: `https://www.cinema-aventure.be/catalogue/?view=table`
- CINEMATEK: `https://cinematek.be/programme/calendrier`
- Nova: `https://www.nova-cinema.org/spip.php?page=seances`
- RITCS: `https://www.cinemaritcs.be/`
- Palace: `https://www.cinema-palace.be/films/wild-horse-nine/`
- Vendôme: `http://www.cinema-vendome.be/les_films/horaires`
- UGC: `https://www.ugc.be/showingsCinemaAjaxAction!getShowingsForCinemaPage.action?cinemaId=2&date=2026-11-07`
- Ciné Boutique: public `media` and `shows` responses advertised by `https://bruxellescinemagaleries.cine.boutique/`
- Flagey: cinema entries from `https://www.flagey.be/en/agenda`
